Write a short academic-style statement about the difference between a calendar anniversary and a collective memory. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: A calendar anniversary marks a fixed date, while collective memory reflects a shared, evolving interpretation. The former is chronological; the latter is social and emotional.
